title: Mochizuki Honami — With A Side Of Compassion〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... This part... I think I can do a slightly better job of stitching it together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to use the same coloration for the previous cut. Um, I'll match the numbers on the bars and... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
These colors aren't quite the same.
But the numbers say they are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is it my eyes? Am I getting tired...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I think I'll take a break in SEKAI and look at the stars.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? Honami?
What are you doing here this late?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was working on our music video and decided to take a little break by seeing the stars here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Miku, you have your guitar...
Were you practicing just now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I was just playing around.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: More importantly, you came to see the stars at the right time. There'll be plenty of shooting stars tonight.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right...
Still, it's amazing how this starry sky always looks so incredibly beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're twinkling so brightly because you girls have such powerful feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember, this SEKAI was born out of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everything here is twinkly and sparkly because all your thoughts and feelings are just as bright and shiny.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, there's a good chance that our feelings are behind why these stars look so beautiful?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Not a good chance. It's a certainty.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only have you girls evolved as a band, your hearts have evolved, too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Also, each of you is doing what you can for Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For example, Honami, you started learning about how to make music videos for that very reason, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Between putting schedules together and making that flyer, I've been wanting to make more contributions to Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But what I was doing didn't really seem all that meaningful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
I really don't think you have to worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that you girls are set on becoming pros, Honami, I'm sure that you're all going to keep growing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There should be plenty for you all to do moving forward, and I have a feeling that only you will be able to handle certain things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, it's cool how you're doing everything you can for the sake of others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're an incredible person, Honami, so you should have confidence in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Thank you for suggesting that we go with a darker tone for our video. It's turning out really well as a result.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Please feel free to ask for help if you ever think you need it, Ichika. I want to help in any way I can!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Honami, you're still up?
No need to worry. I've been making progress bit by bit.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <But I may ask for some advice if I get stuck again.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <For now, let's both keep doing our best!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika might be the one who taught me the value of that.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Boys
rows.Line: Heh heh. If you really want it back, take it back. Hey, catch!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Ichika
rows.Line: Leave Honami alone you big bullies!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She got all muddy in the process, but she got my hat back for me...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to learn how to be more helpful. I want to learn to be cool... Like her.
